symbols.name: first input array
symbols.meaning: The logical array on the first input wire of a two-wire gate.
symbols.quote: Let a two-wire gate have logical input arrays $g_1$ and $g_2$, the arrays on its first and second input wire.

symbols.name: second input array
symbols.meaning: The logical array on the second input wire of a two-wire gate.
symbols.quote: Let a two-wire gate have logical input arrays $g_1$ and $g_2$, the arrays on its first and second input wire.

relations.quote: Each gate and terminal $v$ is a vertex type of [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md), and carries a frame $D_v$, an invertible linear operator on arrays.
